learning_outcomes.text: Analyzes the operating principles of AC and DC chopper circuits under different load types (R, RL, RLE) and calculates fundamental electrical quantities (average voltage, RMS current, power).
Solves rectifier circuits for various load conditions and evaluates rectifier output characteristics using theoretical and analytical methods.
Explains the operating principles of basic inverter topologies and analyzes output waveforms and performance parameters under different load types.
Explains the functions of control and driving circuits used in power electronics systems, and comparatively evaluates triggering and driving strategies.
Examines filter and protection circuits used in power electronics circuits in terms of design criteria and develops solutions to increase system reliability.

syllabus_topics: Solution of AC Chopper Circuits for Various Loads
Solution of DC Chopper Circuits for Various Loads
Solution of Rectifier Circuits for Various Loads
Solution of Inverter Circuits for Various Loads
Investigation of Control and Driving Circuits
